P19-13.name: Unite Counter
P19-13.effect:
When this card is revealed from the deck, you can add it to the Hand.

Besides via Burst effects, when the opponent summons a Spirit without paying at least one cost, you can immediately use the following effect of this card from the Hand, without paying the cost.
█ Destroy any number of opposing Spirits up to a total of 5000 BP. Effects of Spirits destroyed by this effect can't activate. After this effect resolves, by paying one cost, return this card to the Hand.

[Flash]
Return an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit to the deckbottom.
